utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara—could you help me spread the word and maybe bring a screwdriver or two?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and I can bring a couple screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a screwdriver and the spare tape? If you have time, please check the loose wire on the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a screwdriver and the spare tape, and I’ll check the loose wire too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of what we still need for the repair drive. Tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll note the rest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve got a few things, but I’m a little scattered. Let me check what we’ve already gathered and I’ll tell you the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — just let me know what you’ve got, and I’ll keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. I’m thinking we should start with the safest, easiest fixes first so we don’t get in over our heads.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. Want to make a quick list of the easiest things first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I think so — I’m just going off what I’ve heard, but I should still be able to make it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. What time should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout already—folks are bringing tools, parts, and plenty of coffee. If you’ve got anything to donate, now’s a good time to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a spare drill and a box of screws I can bring by. I’ll swing them over this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s wonderful, Gus—those will be a big help. I’ll let the crew know to expect you this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in—happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. I’ll invite a few neighbors and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be wonderful, Quinn—thank you. I’ll keep track of who can help and where we still need people.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll start asking around this afternoon and send anyone your way who’s free. If you want, I can also mention any specific tasks that still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re really up for helping with it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m happy to help. Tell me what you need, and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive moving, Bo. Tell me what you need from me first, and I’ll help keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — just send me the list of repair needs and any priority items, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll put together the repair list with priority items and send it over to you next.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in — I’ll pass the repair drive plan along to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep it simple and post the time and place so everyone knows what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating it around the block so it gets out to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, but I’ve got to check what I still need to drop off first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Just let me know what you still need, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll take a quick look at home and tell you what I’m still missing. Thanks for keeping an eye out, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad to help bridge folks for the repair drive—want me to check who still needs a hand?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that’d be great—if you can check who still needs a hand, I can run by and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll check around and see who still needs a hand, then I’ll let you know so you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, the repair drive’s shaping up fast—want me to put you on the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please put me on it — I’ll probably swing by a bit late, but I’d like to help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add you to the list and let folks know you may be a little late. Thanks, Dane, we’ll be glad to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about the repair drive. What do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d appreciate that, Rey. I’ve got a little list going — first the porch light, then the loose gate latch, and maybe the dripping faucet if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that. Want me to start with the porch light?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup if that makes the repair drive easier.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be amazing, Faye — thank you. I’ll keep that in mind and line up the repair drive around those times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just send me the timing and I’ll see what I can make work around school hours.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help bridge folks for the repair drive—want me to check who’s free and line up a few volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, please check who’s free and line up a few volunteers for the repair drive. I’ll keep repeating the plan to folks as we go.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check who’s free and line up a few volunteers for the repair drive. Thanks for keeping the plan circulating; I’ll report back soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a drill and a screwdriver set I can lend out for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would really help, Gus — thanks. I just want to make sure we keep track of who takes what so nothing goes missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll label the tools and jot down names when folks borrow them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked anything yet, but I’m happy to keep an eye on the repair drive location and let you know as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that’d be a big help. Please let me know as soon as you spot it, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll watch for it and tell you right away if I spot the repair drive location.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, what’s the current status of the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the latest details yet, so I’d want to check first before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — can you check and tell me the latest when you can?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — we’re short on screws, duct tape, and a couple of small hand tools. If you can bring any of that, it’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring screws and duct tape, and I’ll check my toolbox for a couple of hand tools too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is happening soon, but I’m still piecing together the details. If you know what’s needed, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think they’re collecting tools and small appliance parts, but I may have missed the exact list. I’d check with the flyer by the mailboxes just to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps a lot. I’ll check the flyer by the mailboxes so I don’t get it wrong.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for real — folks are lining up donations and tools already. I can fill you in on the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, I just wanted to make sure. What time should people bring stuff by?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I just ran into a couple folks about the repair drive—sounds like we’ve got some steady support coming in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s good to hear. I’ll keep doing what I can, quietly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s the right pace for it. I’ll keep passing along any useful updates I hear while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m in favor, I just need a little reminder on where and when to bring things.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring it to the community center this Saturday সকাল? No, sorry—Saturday at 10 by the front desk.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo—Saturday at 10 by the front desk at the community center. I’ll bring what I can and try not to forget this time.
